purpose: Present a sourced proof point that reduces uncertainty about the product.
whenToUse: A proof point has a traceable source
The source permits its use in the video
whenNotToUse: No reliable proof point is supplied
A quote, metric, logo, award, or attribution cannot be verified
requiredInputs: source URL or owned source asset

layoutContract.source: Keep attribution readable and adjacent to the claim.
layoutContract.density: Use one proof point per scene.

motionContract.entrance: Reveal the claim and its attribution as a single unit.
motionContract.determinism: Use finite, paused animation with fixed values.
motionContract.emphasis: Emphasize only the exact verified fragment; do not animate a larger implied claim.

transitionOptions.use: Reveal a sourced metric or quote over product context.
Move from evidence to the CTA without implying causation.

captionRules.copy: Preserve the meaning and qualifiers of the source.
captionRules.placement: Do not separate a claim from its visible attribution.

fallbacks.condition: proof is absent, stale, or unverified
fallbacks.action: Skip the scene and redistribute time; never synthesize proof.
Use text attribution if authorized, otherwise omit the proof point.

qaRules: Every claim has a recorded source
Unknown-license imagery and unverified customer logos are absent
